user.title: Set up ClimateOptimizer
user.description: Pick the sensors this zone should use. Everything else can be tuned later via Configure.

data.name: Name
data.weather_entity: Weather entity (optional, for wind and sun)

data_description.heating_type: How fast your heating can respond. Underfloor heating is buried in a slab and takes hours; radiators react much faster. Used to keep self-tuning from correcting faster than your system can physically deliver.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure ClimateOptimizer
reconfigure.description: Change the sensors this zone uses.

data.name: Name
data.weather_entity: Weather entity (optional, for wind and sun)

abort.already_configured: A ClimateOptimizer zone for this indoor sensor already exists.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the OhmOnWifi device at that hostname/IP. Check it's powered on, connected, and the address is correct.

init.title: ClimateOptimizer options
init.description: Pick a section to edit. Each page saves on its own.

sensors.title: Sensors and inputs
sensors.description: Which entities to read, and which weather-derived inputs to use at all. Switching an input off removes it from the thermal model too, not just from the calculation.

data.power_sensor: Heat pump power sensor (optional, may include hot water)

data_description.weather_entity: Only used for wind and sun. Leave empty if both inputs below are off.
data_description.enable_solar_input: Backs the heating off when the sun is warming the house.
data_description.enable_wind_input: Compensates for extra heat loss on windy days.

comfort.title: Comfort
comfort.description: Your preferences. Nothing here is ever auto-tuned — no measurement of the house can tell us what temperature you want. The target temperature itself is a separate entity so automations can move it.

data.heating_cutoff_c: Summer cutoff (compensation off at/above this outdoor temperature)

tuning.title: Tuning
tuning.description: Manual uses the coefficients below. Auto derives them from your house's measured thermal behaviour instead, easing across as the model gathers evidence and falling back to these values whenever it isn't confident. The derived numbers are published on the auto-tune sensor in both modes, so you can compare before committing. To switch modes later, use the tuning-mode entity rather than this page.

data_description.heating_type: Keeps self-tuning from correcting faster than your emitters can physically respond.
data_description.k_indoor: Starting point in Auto mode, and the fallback whenever the model isn't trusted.

price.title: Price and savings
price.description: How hard to trade comfort for cheaper energy. The Low/Mid/High tier is a separate entity so it can be automated. With a day-ahead forecast the price band is taken from the day's own spread and the two thresholds below are only a fallback. In Auto mode the deep-cold taper is replaced by a recovery-feasibility calculation from the thermal model.

data.enable_price_compensation: Lower target during expensive price periods
data.precharge_max_boost_c: Max pre-heat boost before a spike (High tier only; 0 disables)
data.price_threshold_max: Price where reduction is at its maximum (fallback)
data.cold_taper_start_c: Deep-cold taper: full braking at/above this outdoor temp
data.cold_taper_full_c: Deep-cold taper: minimum braking at/below this outdoor temp
data.cold_taper_min_factor: Deep-cold taper: braking fraction at the coldest end (0-1)

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Experimental model settings. The MPC planner is advisory only and never affects the published temperature.

data.enable_wind_rc: Estimate wind sensitivity in the thermal model (only for leaky, exposed houses)
data.rc_wind_reference_ms: Reference wind speed for the wind model
data.mpc_min_confidence: MPC minimum RC-model confidence to be trustworthy
data.enable_data_logging: Log data locally for offline model testing

output.title: Output push
output.description: Optional ways to send the compensated temperature to your heat pump. Both are independent — set one, both, or neither.

output_number_push.name: Update a number entity
output_number_push.description: Sets the published compensated outdoor temperature into a number entity, e.g. `number.ohmigo_temperature` if OhmOnWifi/OhmigoWifi is set up as a MQTT entity. Mirrors what the main sensor publishes (real outdoor temp while the activation switch is off/learn-mode, compensated once it's on). Off by default.

ohmonwifi_direct.name: OhmOnWifi direct API
ohmonwifi_direct.description: Push the compensated outdoor temperature straight to an OhmOnWifi/Ohmigo device's own local HTTP API. Off by default. The save is rejected if it can't be reached.

data.ohmonwifi_host: Hostname or IP (optional, e.g. ohmonwifi.local - the device's own mDNS default name)

rc_thermal_time_constant.name: Learned: RC model thermal time constant

rc_heat_pump_gain.name: Learned: RC model heat pump gain

mpc_planned_next_temperature.name: Learned: MPC planned next indoor temperature
